hard_gate_failures: Format: the listicle recipe calls for 8–10 slides and this one has 6, because only 4 items were verified. The lesson says to confirm enough verified prices to fill the slide count before choosing the topic.
Design rule: the cover headline runs 7 words ('4 first dive watches' plus '$925 to $1,400'). The limit is 6.
Caption claim_ids: the Tissot slide and caption state 'Powermatic 80' and '43mm'. No verified claim covers either one, and CLM-TISSOT-PRICE only supports the price.
fixes: Whole post: verify 2–4 more first-dive-watch prices in the same band (about $900–$1,500) from dated official US pages, and add one slide per watch. This brings the post to 8+ slides. If that isn't possible, pick another topic.
slide 1: shorten the headline to 6 words or fewer, e.g. '4 first dive watches' with a 'From $925' second line, or drop the price range from the headline.
slide 4: add a verified Tissot spec claim for 43mm and Powermatic 80, with its claim_id in the caption. Otherwise remove 'Powermatic 80' and '43mm' from the slide and caption.
caption: add CLM-HAM-SPEC, CLM-SEIKO143-SPEC and any new Tissot spec claim to claim_ids for every spec the slides show.
reason: The prices I checked and the Hamilton page are accurate, the photos are official and credited, and the validate check passes. It can't go out because it has 6 slides where the format needs 8–10, the cover headline is 7 words, and the Tissot specs have no verified claim behind them.
